title: AIS Traffic Density and Quiet Periods
dataSources: Aircraft messages (`adsb:message`), APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), AIS vessel messages (`ais:message`), rtl_433 decodes (`rtl433:sensor`), RF occupancy summaries (`sdr:spectrum`), satellite observations (`satnogs:observation`), and repeater use (`repeater:activity`).
app: Radio and SDR telemetry from WSPR, APRS, ADS-B, AIS, rtl_433, SatNOGS, and local receiver health feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and log shippers.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ais:message
| bin _time span=1h
| stats dc(mmsi) as vessels by _time
| where vessels<5 OR vessels>25
description: Highlights unusually quiet and unusually busy marine traffic hours from your local AIS feed.
value: Density swings tell you when the waterway behaves differently from normal, whether because of weather, events, or seasonality.
implementation: Ship AIS messages from rtl_ais or an API and review hourly distinct-vessel counts.
visualization: Timeline of hourly vessel counts with quiet and busy periods emphasized.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when ship traffic is much quieter or busier than normal in the waters you monitor.
